usage: The word '揚州炒飯' is a noun referring to a specific type of fried rice from Yangzhou.
It is often used as a menu item in restaurants and can function as the subject or object in a sentence.
When talking about ordering food, you can say '我想要一碟揚州炒飯' (I want a plate of Yangzhou fried rice).
It can be combined with quantities or preferences, such as '唔加蝦嘅揚州炒飯' (Yangzhou fried rice without shrimp).
You can also ask questions about it: '呢間有冇揚州炒飯？' (Does this place have Yangzhou fried rice?).
